text:
anika: Heads-up: scheduling a coordinated base-image rebuild + runtime hardening this Wed 03:00-06:00 UTC. Goals: remove lang runtimes we don't use, enable rootless runtime flags, rotate the image-signer credentials, and switch signing to the KMS-wrapped signer. Affects Dedicated + Private clusters.

sam: Sounds good. Which RBAC delta do we need? will this touch workload identities or cloud roles?

anika: We'll create a dedicated k8s serviceaccount `infra:image-signer` with minimized privileges. Draft Role: 
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: image-signer-role
  namespace: infra
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get"]
- apiGroups: ["apps"]
  resources: ["deployments"]
  verbs: ["get"]
```
We will NOT grant cluster-admin. For canaries we'll add a RoleBinding scoped to the canary ns.

liam: KMS integration note: cloud KMS needs `cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the signer principal for wrap/unwrap. We should request `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the specific key resource. HSM not required for initial cutover.

maria: Audit and vuln gating are critical: 1) all signing calls and RBAC modifications must be logged and forwarded to Splunk with 365d retention, 2) the pipeline must fail canary promotion if vulnerability scanner finds any CRITICAL or more than 5 HIGHs.

kevin: For audit: we'll add an `audit-policy` rule so write events for rbac.authorization.k8s.io and any requests by the `system:serviceaccount:infra:image-signer` user get RequestBody captured. Example match: `user == "system:serviceaccount:infra:image-signer" || requestURI contains "/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io"`. We'll also add a logging sidecar to the signer deployment to push `/var/log/signer.log` to secure-splunk.

ops: Paging plan: ops-oncall gets paged if signer_error_rate > 1% or signer_latency_p95 > 500ms sustained for 5m. We'll pre-create fallback read-only image cache in case signing is unavailable so pulls don't block.

sam: CI/infra detail: use a short-lived credential job to apply the canary RoleBinding. Example command: 
```
kubectl create rolebinding signer-canary-binding --role=image-signer-role --serviceaccount=infra:image-signer --namespace=canary
```
Run that from the `ci/infra` runner using ephemeral creds. Do not rotate or delete old bindings until 48h stable.

maria: I'll wire Trivy into the preflight job. Plan: build image -> generate SBOM -> run trivy + grype -> fail if CRITICAL OR count(HIGH) > 5. SBOM gets uploaded to artifact-store with checksum.

liam: Signer config snippet for new KMS mode: 
```json
{"signer": {"kms_key": "projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/signing-2026", "wrap": "kms"}}
```
Ensure the signer service account has the KMS role on that key. I'll open an IAM ticket and tag cloud-ops.

kevin: RBAC rollout: use feature toggle `image_signer_v2` in the infra config. Initially create RoleBindings in `canary` ns only. After 24-48h, add infra ns binding and then gradually update other namespaces. We'll capture approver in the audit log (approve PR + merge author).

anika: Canary runbook (sketch):
- Build minimal base image (alpine-musl/distroless)
- Generate SBOM, upload
- Run vulnerability scan, run functional smoke tests
- Deploy canary to fenced cluster with `image-policy: canary`
- Monitor metrics for 24h (signing_latency_p50/p95, image_pull_errors, container_start_failures)
- If scans fail or telemetry regressions, trigger auto-rollback and open incident

ops: We'll also keep a traffic-splitting policy that routes 5% to canary initially. If stability holds for 6h, bump to 25% then 100% after 24h.

maria: Telemetry dashboards I'll add: `signer_latency_p50`, `signer_latency_p95`, `signer_error_rate`, `image_pull_errors`, `admission_denials`. I'll add alert thresholds and a short CIRCA dashboard for the war-room.

sam: Add an admission webhook log filter for quick denial reasons during canary. That helped last time.

liam: IAM update: opened ticket CLOUD-1792 to grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the signing key to `serviceAccount:signer@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. ETA 6h.

kevin: I'll raise the audit-policy PR and include a test that asserts the audit logs contain `user=system:serviceaccount:infra:image-signer` events for signing API calls.

anika: I'll open the release-war-room thread and attach the runbook and rollback steps. Ops, please confirm on-call coverage for Wed 03:00-09:00 UTC (buffer).

ops: confirmed. We'll standby.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: base-image-rebuild-2026-04-01 at 2026-04-01T03:00:00Z (initiated by anika). Artifact: gcr.io/redwood/base/minimal:20260401-canary.

maria: quick follow-up: please ensure the SBOM format includes package versions + source digests (Syft SPDX + CycloneDX). Also preserve SBOM as part of the artifact metadata for later vuln triage.

sam: Action items recap: sam = RBAC playbook + CI job for ephemeral binding; liam = IAM ticket + signer config; maria = SBOM + preflight scans; kevin = audit-policy PR + Splunk pipeline; ops = on-call + fallback cache + traffic split.

anika: Thanks all. We'll reconvene Mon EOD for final sign-off. If anyone hits a blocker before then ping me. :thumbsup:
